answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a anchor as the anchor of the cost. A ripple stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a marble...
